laws.rule: Parque Nacional Bosque Fray Jorge: The published notice says rain damage prevents vehicle access to the relict forest approach and access to Bosque Relicto and Universal trails. Check current trail notices rather than assuming the whole park or all trails are closed. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.
